test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_prewhere_compact (c1 DateTime, c2 LowCardinality(String), c3 LowCardinality(String), c4 LowCardinality(String), c5 UInt32, c6 UInt32, c7 UInt32, c8 UInt32, c9 Nullable(Float32), c10 Float32) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toYYYYMMDD(c1) ORDER BY (c1, c2) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192, min_bytes_for_wide_part = '1T', min_rows_for_wide_part = 1000000000000
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_prewhere_compact SELECT toDateTime('2025-01-01 00:00:00') + intDiv(number, 32000) * 3600, concat('r', toString(cityHash64(number, 1) % 30)), lower(concat(hex(cityHash64(cityHash64(number, 2) % 2000000)), hex(cityHash64(cityHash64(number, 2) % 2000000, 1)))), concat('m', toString(cityHash64(number, 3) % 6)), cityHash64(number, 4) % 2, 1, cityHash64(number, 5) % 2, cityHash64(number, 6) % 2, if(cityHash64(number, 7) % 10 = 0, NULL, toFloat32(cityHash64(number, 8) % 600)), toFloat32(cityHash64(number, 9) % 2) FROM numbers(64000000)
test.query: SELECT toStartOfMonth(toDate(c1)) AS p901, c4, round((100 * sum(c5)) / sum(c6), 2) AS a1, round((100 * sum(c7)) / sum(c6), 2) AS a2, round((100 * sum(c8)) / sum(c6), 2) AS a3, round(sum(c9) / sum(c10), 2) AS a4 FROM t_prewhere_compact WHERE (c2 = 'r2') AND ((toDate(c1) >= '2024-09-01') AND (toDate(c1) <= '2026-10-11')) AND ((toMonth(toDate(c1)) != 10) OR (toDayOfMonth(toDate(c1)) <= 11) OR (toYear(toDate(c1)) = 2024)) AND (c3 NOT IN ('a1', 'a2', 'a3', 'a4', 'a5', 'a6', 'a7', 'a8')) AND (c4 IN ('m1', 'm2', 'm3', 'm4')) GROUP BY p901, c4 ORDER BY c4 ASC, p901 ASC FORMAT Null
